Represent the glossy chitin material through intrinsic dark violet colour and subtle purple painted variation, not white shine. All faces equally readable. Glowing orange is painted colour only, no bloom or light spill.
No background, no floor, no text, no watermark, no added objects, no added protrusions. Preserve the original transparent canvas and exact guide silhouette including bottom notches.
